responsibility: Implements the include-style Rust builtin macros in the expansion subsystem. This file handles include_bytes!, include_str!, and include! by parsing a single string-literal path argument, resolving it relative to the including source file, reading file contents, validating UTF-8 for include_str!, constructing borrowed byte-array or string literal AST fragments for the first two cases, and lexing/parsing the referenced source file into item fragments for include! with appropriate diagnostics and source-location context.
